name: KTown Landscaping
h1: Landscaping, walls and excavation across the Central Okanagan.
lede: Locally owned and fully equipped. From paver patios and block walls to bobcat work, demolition and fire damage clean-up, for homes and businesses.

services.label: Excavation
services.title: Excavation and demolition
services.text: Bobcats and excavators for the major projects.

found_via: came across KTown while looking at landscapers in Kelowna
compliment: A 4.9 on Google and a service list that runs from paver patios to fire damage clean-up says you can handle just about anything.
gap: Your website doesn't use https, so Chrome and Safari show visitors a "Not secure" warning, and the phone number can't be tapped to call.
pitch_line: It shows the full range of work clearly, works properly on a phone, and has a quote form and a tap-to-call button.
